verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's own docs say it registers you where required and "files and remits on schedule" everywhere you sell, and filings are exposed per jurisdiction and per registration through the API. Nothing in the evidence covers a vendor guarantee against late-filing penalties, which is a core part of this story. Missing for 10: any documented penalty or late-filing guarantee, detail on how returns are prepared and on remittance mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of on-time filing.

support.subject: As a finance lead, returns are prepared, filed, and remitted automatically in every registered jurisdiction — on time, with the vendor's guarantee covering penalties if it files late

citations.quote: registers you in the jurisdictions that require it, and files and remits on schedule
registers you, and files everywhere you sell
The Get Filings API retrieves a paginated list of filings based on filters such as dates, jurisdiction, Country, status, etc.
